The predecessor of the Agricultural Bank of China (“ABC” or “the Bank”) was the Agricultural Cooperative Bank established in 1951.

The Bank was restructured into a joint stock limited liability company in January of 2009, and was listed on both the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong in July, 2010.
